headline: India Oil and Gas Import Bill Surges 60% in October to $16 Billion
summary: India's energy import expenditures jumped 60% year-over-year in October 2026 to $16 billion, up from $10 billion in October 2025, driven by a near-doubling in crude oil prices.
why: India is the world's third-largest crude oil importer, making its trade balance and currency highly sensitive to international energy prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
